summary_ja: 金融庁長官が基礎的・先進的内部格付手法の承認に当たり審査する基準(三年以上の使用実績、最低要件の充足見込み、計画の合理性)を定める。
summary_en: Sets the standards the Commissioner examines when approving the foundation or advanced approach: at least three years of use of a conforming internal rating system, expected compliance with the minimum requirements, and a reasonable plan.
paragraphs: In the cases listed in the following items, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency shall examine whether the standards specified in each such item are satisfied. (i) Where approving an Ultimate Designated Parent Company as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach: that it has used, for at least three years before the approval, an internal rating system conforming to the minimum requirements provided in Subsections 1 through 6 of Section 4; that it is expected to satisfy the minimum requirements provided in Subsections 7 and 8 of that Section on and after the date on which use of the internal ratings-based approach begins; and that the internal ratings-based approach implementation plan is reasonable; provided, however, that this does not prevent improvements to the internal rating system. (ii) Where approving an Ultimate Designated Parent Company as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach: that it has used, for at least three years before the approval, an internal rating system conforming to the minimum requirements for using estimates of LGD and EAD provided in Subsection 5, Divisions 4 through 6 of Section 4; that the internal ratings-based approach implementation plan or the advanced internal ratings-based approach transition plan is reasonable; and that it satisfies the standards in the preceding item; provided, however, that this does not prevent improvements to the internal rating system.
